research_question: Which materials, operations and technical noun phrases occur in a declared chemical-protocol corpus, and which contextual references need separate anaphora annotation?
inclusion_criteria: Include reagent names, instruments, operations and technical noun phrases with exact step or page evidence.
Include established vocabulary and preserve context-sensitive expressions; coreference annotations are external human/model research outputs.
exclusion_criteria: Exclude generic anaphors such as the mixture from a reagent glossary unless the study explicitly includes them as reference expressions.
Do not infer unobserved antecedents, reaction results or chemical instructions from extracted terms.

positive.text: The protocol identifies Bromoacetyl bromide as a reagent.
positive.sense: a reagent named in this protocol
positive.reason: SYNTHETIC GUIDE EXAMPLE. Synthetic illustration using a material named in the MICE paper; no experimental procedure is supplied.

negative.reason: SYNTHETIC GUIDE EXAMPLE. General vocabulary is outside the protocol glossary.

boundary.text: The next sentence refers to the mixture without naming its components.
boundary.reason: SYNTHETIC GUIDE EXAMPLE. Occurrence is inspectable, but antecedent identity needs an external coreference annotation.

protocol_term_type.description: Suggested material, instrument, operation or technical_noun_phrase category.

step_role.description: Suggested local step role if supported by text.

reference_note.description: Suggested unresolved reference issue; not a validated antecedent.

specialist_lenses.lens: Attend to full reagent names, instruments and operations in protocol text.
Attend to context-sensitive technical noun phrases and reference expressions, without resolving antecedents automatically.
